title: Egg Roll in a Bowl for the Crew
displayTitle: Egg Roll in a Bowl for the Crew
seoTitle: Egg Roll in a Bowl for the Crew | Firefighter Meal
shortDescription: Fast pork and cabbage skillet with takeout flavour
subtitle: Fast pork and cabbage skillet with takeout flavour
description: Ground pork, cabbage, carrots, ginger, and sesame are stir-fried and served over rice.

steps.title: Start rice
steps.instruction: Start rice first because it needs covered steaming time while the skillet cooks.

steps.title: Mix sauce
steps.instruction: Stir soy sauce, ginger, garlic, sesame oil, and a little brown sugar in a bowl.

steps.title: Heat skillet
steps.instruction: Heat a large skillet or griddle over medium-high and add a thin layer of oil.

steps.title: Brown pork
steps.instruction: Break pork into small crumbles and cook until browned with no pink showing.

steps.title: Confirm temperature
steps.instruction: Check several pork crumbles; they must reach 165°F before holding.

steps.title: Add cabbage
steps.instruction: Add coleslaw mix in handfuls, stirring after each addition so it contacts the heat.

steps.title: Pour sauce
steps.instruction: Pour sauce around the pan edge and toss for 2 minutes; avoid soaking the cabbage.

steps.title: Finish texture
steps.instruction: Stop cooking when cabbage is wilted but still has crunch, not limp and wet.

steps.title: Hold components
steps.instruction: Keep pork mixture above 140°F and fluff rice just before the break.

steps.title: Top bowls
steps.instruction: Spoon rice and pork mixture into bowls, then scatter green onions and sesame seeds.

steps.title: Hold for call interruptions
steps.instruction: If tones drop mid-cook: turn off direct heat and cover Ground pork — hold at 140°F in a warm cabinet or 200°F oven, never below 140°F for more than 30 minutes cumulative. Log hold time on the pan with a grease pencil. If tones drop after service, cover hot food and keep sides on low heat or ice as appropriate. On return, spot-check proteins at safe internal temp before reopening the line.

steps.title: Pack down leftovers safely
steps.instruction: Cool Ground pork and hot components in shallow hotel pans within two hours — deep pots stay in the danger zone too long. Label with date; reheat proteins to 165°F minimum before second shift. Store cold components separately so textures survive overnight.

proTips: Use a griddle for the fastest cabbage cook.
Add chili oil at the table.
Do not salt early; soy sauce is salty.
tonightSpread: Main: Pork egg roll skillet bowls
Condiments: chili oil, sesame seeds, soy sauce
Set hot components closest to the crew; cold crunch and toppings at the far end of the line.
Keep a backup tray at 200°F for firefighters returning from a run.
leftovers: Cool Ground pork in shallow pans within two hours; label with date and reheat to 165°F before second shift.
Store cold sides separately — hot and cold stacked overnight ruins texture.
Fold into lettuce wraps the next day.
whyCrewsLikeIt: It uses one large pan and forgiving ingredients that can wait for a call.
mealPrepNotes: Make-ahead: shred vegetables and mix sauce 2 days ahead. Storage: refrigerate for 3 days. Reheating: heat pork mixture to 165°F.
substitutions: Use cauliflower rice for lower carbs.
